args: Implement docs/plans/trustworthy-simple-building-code-plan.md using only data already in the repository: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 make every page show the same release and remove internal references from public copy, with CI checks; Part 2 enforce text fidelity in CI (every provision's text found on its cited page or covered by a recorded correction), remove editorial insertions into labelled site notes, restore table digests as real tables, correct OCR against page images or mark unreadable, strip gazette headers; Part 3 repair structure (dates never clause numbers, remove duplicates, list items as siblings, depth and uniqueness checks, real table captions, non-content excluded from topics); Part 4 explicit instrument types (compilation, map and bill never shown as in force), explain the 2017 notification's relationship to bye-law 1.4 with quotes, evidence-backed authority succession, statuses re-derived from evidence; Part 5 tables as data, parameter records for coverage, FAR, setbacks, height, floors and parking with intervals and cell sources, resolution rules as data with quoted authorities, resolver in pipeline and browser tested from source tables including the Jayanagar 600 m² / 15 m road case, 40-record self-check; Part 6 map-first home with a readable light base map, plot card with plain answers and tap-to-expand detail, most-recent-first lists everywhere with law order inside documents, plain primary layer with details on expand, Rules by subject showing what applies today first, page budgets and browser tests in CI; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md resumable and the PR's For owner review, Decisions made and Known gaps sections current; never invent or rewrite legal text, never present anything as verified by a person.
